extracted.name: Cranberry Sauce with Orange Juice and Brown Sugar
extracted.description: This cranberry sauce with orange juice and brown sugar is spiced with ginger, cloves, and citrus zest for a family favorite, not just on Thanksgiving.
instruction_lines: Combine water, brown sugar, orange juice, cinnamon stick, ginger, orange zest, salt, cloves, and allspice in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until sugar is dissolved, 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in cranberries and return to a boil over medium heat. Cook until cranberries start to burst and mixture thickens slightly, 8 to 10 minutes; sauce will thicken further upon cooling.
Transfer cranberry sauce to a bowl; remove and discard cinnamon stick. Store in the refrigerator until serving.
